item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We demand a legally binding prohibition on its development.

2. We will not accept a billion deaths as the price of technological progress. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe on that scale. We must prohibit its development by law.

3. We cannot leave humanity’s future to companies racing to build superintelligence. If they succeed within the next 20 years, at least a billion people will die in the resulting catastrophe. We demand a binding legal prohibition.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We refuse to accept that future. No one knows how to build these systems safely, and we cannot allow humanity to become the testing ground. We are calling for a legally binding prohibition on developing superintelligence—not voluntary promises, not another industry pledge, and not assurances that safety will somehow catch up. We must act before these systems exist. Together, we can demand laws that put human survival ahead of the race to build machines more powerful than ourselves.
